01 / WHAT I CAN HELP WITH

A good first impression.
A useful next step.

Start with what your business needs today. Agree the pages, content, features, and price before the work begins.

01 ↗

A focused landing page

One clear destination for a service, launch, or offer. Give visitors the essentials and an obvious way to enquire.

  • Responsive single-page design
  • Clear content and calls to action
  • Basic page titles and descriptions
02 ↗

A small business website

A considered home for your business, with room for your services, story, and work.

  • Page count agreed in advance
  • Service and portfolio sections
  • Email or existing booking links
03 ↗

A refresh & a handover

Give an existing static website a clearer structure, or get help preparing your new site for launch.

  • Layout and content refinements
  • Mobile and link checks
  • Source files and editing notes

Every project starts with a written scope. Domains, paid tools, copy translation, ongoing maintenance, and advanced features are only included if specifically agreed. No ranking or sales guarantees.

03 / A PERSONAL APPROACH

AI in the process.
Care in the details.

I’m Adam, building an independent website service from Morocco for local and international small businesses.

AI helps me explore layouts, draft code, and refine content. I guide the work, check the finished pages, and work with you to make the result fit your business. Siteora is the working name for this new service.

I’m starting with focused websites and honest scope. If an idea needs specialist systems or ongoing support beyond what I can provide, we’ll clarify that before committing.

FROM IDEA TO HANDOVER

01

Define

Your goals, audience, content, and essential features. A clear scope before a quote.

02

Design & refine

A first direction, then feedback and revisions within the agreed scope.

03

Check & launch

Review phone and desktop layouts, check links, and prepare the agreed hosting.

04

Make it yours

Receive your source files and simple handover notes. Ongoing work is agreed separately.
